subject: E-1285: quota exceeded on Windows
body:
Good morning. My setup is SyncVault 4.2.5, Windows 11 23H2. Whenever I start a
sync since the weekend, the app shows "E-1285: storage quota exceeded".

The plan was upgraded yesterday; the app still displays the old quota. The
website shows the new allowance correctly.

Before writing in I tried rebooting the router; same error afterwards.

Regards, Fatima Zahra, Pinewood Legal
